**Mind Over Matter (Su):** At 14th level, you cannot die of old age, although you continue aging until you reach your maximum age. You cannot lose consciousness unless you choose to, even when dying. You are still staggered when at 0 or fewer hit points. This ability only allows you to take purely mental actions if you are below 0 hit points. Although you can be stabilized, you still lose hit points if you take a standard action. This ability replaces the discipline power gained at 14th level.

**Unbound Consciousness (Su):** At 15th level, you can leave your body, gaining the incorporeal subtype and the incorporeal quality, for 1 round per psion level. While outside your body, you cannot activate items or interact with objects except those with the ghost touch property. Divide your hit point total evenly between your body and incorporeal mind; nothing affecting one affects the other, except for spells and magic items that do not require activation (which apply fully to both as long as your body is alive). Your body is helpless as long as your mind is apart from it. You can dismiss this projection early as a standard action, returning instantly to your body. At 20th level, you can use this ability indefinitely, but if you are apart from your body for more than 24 hours, you lose the benefit of all spells and items affecting your body. This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 15th level and 20th level.
